_comment: MT056 (2026-08-18) — durable per-product record of README publication events to the real upstream FOSS repos. Exists because republication debt previously lived only in the plan's taskcard register and was LOST there (TC-HARDEN-47/48, re-registered by MT056 §4 — the two live Mermaid-clipping defects on 3d/net and 3d/python published upstream). readme_refresh_run.py's audit-portfolio consumes this via check key 'published_readme_current' (advisory): a product listed here whose clone-cache README.md no longer matches the canonical candidate is flagged 'republication pending' on every audit run, so the debt is mechanically re-derived instead of remembered. _do_push appends/updates an entry on every real (non-dry-run) push. Seeded 2026-08-18 from the authoritative plan's own recorded PR/merge history — each entry cites its plan evidence; products with no confirmed publication record are deliberately absent, never guessed.
